status: Read from the manual text and checked against the quick-start guide; every setup agrees between the two. Re-verify visually with knowledge/factcheck/FACT_CHECK.md section 4.

mig.label: MIG (solid wire with shielding gas)
other_connections: MIG gun cable connector into the socket on the wire feed mechanism (fully inserted, then tighten the knob; do not overtighten)
Wire Feed Control Cable into the Wire Feed Control Socket inside the machine (one orientation only, tighten the lock ring)
mig.gas: Shielding gas required: set 20-30 SCFH; see the Settings Chart inside the welder door for the gas type

flux_cored.label: Flux-cored (gasless, self-shielded)
other_connections: MIG gun cable connector into the socket on the wire feed mechanism
Wire Feed Control Cable into the Wire Feed Control Socket inside the machine

tig.label: TIG (DC)
tig.polarity_name: Not labeled DCEN/DCEP in the manual (manual says 'DC TIG'). Torch in the negative socket means electrode negative; that mapping is an inference.
other_connections: Foot Pedal Cable (foot pedal sold separately) through the front hole into the Foot Pedal Socket inside the machine; tighten the collar clockwise
Shielding gas hose from the TIG torch cable connector to the regulator outlet
Leave the Wire Feed Power Cable disconnected (quick-start guide)

stick.label: Stick
stick.polarity_name: Not labeled DCEN/DCEP in the manual. Electrode holder in the positive socket means electrode positive; that mapping is an inference.
other_connections: Leave the Wire Feed Power Cable disconnected (quick-start guide)

spool_gun.label: Spool gun (optional, for aluminum MIG)
spool_gun.polarity_name: Same as MIG (clamp negative, wire feed power positive); manual does not name it
other_connections: Spool Gun Cable Connector into the socket on the wire feed mechanism (fully inserted or the gas connection leaks)
Wire Feed Control Cable into the Wire Feed Control Socket inside the machine
Spool Gun gas hose to the Spool Gun Gas Outlet on the front panel
spool_gun.gas: Shielding gas required; see paragraph 17 on p14 for gas setup
